可追溯的科研證據驗證

Traceable Research Evidence Verification

以公開的 paper-evidence 驗證核心，檢查研究草稿的引文和數字是否可回溯。

產業問題與工程挑戰

長文獻或多來源摘要可能混淆引用內容與作者的推論，尤其是數字、對象和表述範圍。

工程限制

查到一段相關文字不表示它支持主張。需要把主張依據、原文與適用條件留在同一條稽核鏈上。

技術方法與架構

實作與交付

公開工具的標準函式庫核心可獨立檢查文字和數字。語意判斷的設定及額外的文獻搜尋工具另有先決條件。

成果

已對公開查核核心重跑四組合成引文。逐字引用與排版正規化通過，出現在其他段落的數字及原文找不到的引文被攔下。

  • 可查閱的驗證核心
  • 基本查核範例與公開使用說明

驗證與證據

固定公開版本與合成文字重現查核，停用模糊比對，數字須出現在引文前後各 200 字元的查核範圍。此實跑不含 LLM 語意判斷或科研推論。

Technical Note

Traceable Research Evidence Verification

Independent Open-source Tool · Open Source

Use the public paper-evidence verification core to check whether quotations and numbers in a research draft trace back to the literature.

Open full English page 繁體中文 Plan a project Replay the recorded quote checks Technical diagram

Industry problem and engineering challenge

Summaries of long papers and multiple sources can confuse what the text says with an interpretation, especially for numeric claims and their subjects.

Engineering constraints

A relevant quote may not support a claim. Claims, source text and applicable context should remain together in an audit trail.

Technical approach and architecture

Implementation and deliverables

The published standard-library core checks text and numeric context separately. Semantic judgment and additional literature search have separate configuration requirements.

Outcome

Four synthetic inputs were run against the public quote gate. Exact and normalized quotations passed. A number from a separate section and an unlocated quotation were blocked.

  • Inspectable verification core
  • Basic checks and public documentation

Validation and evidence

Reproduction uses pinned public code and synthetic text, with fuzzy matching disabled and a 200-character numeric window on each side of the quotation. The run does not assess LLM faithfulness or scientific inference.

Public evidence classification · Reproducible experiment

Controlled recorded run

Recorded execution of the public quote gate

Four synthetic quotations exercise a pinned public revision against exact matches, normalized formatting, misplaced numbers and invented quotes.
